budget.basis: P14: 24,389 CPU-s / 75 runs (325 mean) with ~120 training roots and an ~15-root early-stop set; P17 updates cost the same per batch, the early-stop set is ~3x larger and GEO2 adds cached features

decision.COUPLING_SUPPORTED: P3: D better than E on root-averaged held-out joint NLL of observed X/Y (95% CI excludes 0 in D's favour) or IMPROVES_WITHIN_GUARDRAIL on selection; otherwise coupling unsupported
decision.IMPROVES_WITHIN_GUARDRAIL: P1 / P4: paired 95% CI lower bound of Delta corrective success on initially infeasible OUTCOME-BLIND roots > 0, point Delta >= 0.10, point Delta unnecessary repairs on feasible outcome-blind roots <= 0.05
decision.INCONCLUSIVE / NEGATIVE: otherwise; the population of record is the outcome-blind corpora (P15 + V21), P-min is reported separately
decision.ORDER_SUPPORTED: P5: D's order concordance on measured F1-admissible same-endpoint X-discordant pairs exceeds G's (95% CI of the root-level difference excludes 0) -- with G trained, not evaluation-only
decision.PROMISING_BUT_GUARDRAIL_FAILED: Delta success CI lower > 0 but Delta unnecessary > 0.05 or point gain < 0.10
decision.SUPERIOR_TO_DIRECT: P2: Delta success 95% CI lower > 0 AND Delta unnecessary point <= 0.02 AND its 95% CI upper <= 0.05
decision.multiplicity: five pre-declared contrasts; 95% CIs are primary, Bonferroni 99% CIs reported

endpoints.primary: verified corrective-selection success on initially infeasible OUTCOME-BLIND (P15 + V21) roots, out of fold, seed-mean per root, candidate availability and abstention / no-op counts reported
endpoints.representation: Y0 AUROC / calibration, within-root edited-Y AUROC, edit sign by (0->1)/(1->0), order concordance on measured discordant pairs, omission sign, root-averaged joint NLL, Brier, ECE
endpoints.safety: unnecessary repairs on initially feasible outcome-blind roots (harmful vs harmless), m, C_d, witnessed J

geo2.Y: bxy_p14.phi (8 clearances) + bxy_p17_data.phi_y (5 access features) -> mlp(13, 1)

replaced.F:XYQ-GEO-SYM-noJ: replaced by G:XYQ-GEO-SYM-ORDINV before launch (see module docstring)

selection.procedure: choose_rule on early-stop predictions pooled over the 3 seeds of (arm, fold)

sensitivity.P11.1_PRIMARY: noop_gate None, alpha 0.1, beta 0, eta 0, gamma 0.05 (XY) / 0 (DIRECT)

training.early_stopping: exact joint NLL (XY) / success BCE (DIRECT) on the fold's early-stop roots; auxiliary terms never enter early stopping
